info.title: vvvv-mcp
info.description: MCP server for vvvv gamma. Search 6400+ nodes, read/write .vl patches, generate C# nodes and SDSL shaders, access the full Gray Book knowledge base, and connect to a live running vvvv instance via the VL.MCP.HDE editor extension. Works without a vvvv installation for all knowledge and patch tools.
